summary: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting a regular distribution of $0.20 per Class I share, payable in cash or reinvested, with a record date of May 29, 2026, and payment on June 24, 2026. It also disclosed its net asset value per Class I share of $25.76 as of April 30, 2026, total net assets of $104.2M, debt of $119.4M (1.15x debt-to-equity), and a portfolio update with 39 companies. This is a routine dividend and portfolio disclosure, not a special situation.
